metadata.description: Открытый маркетплейс скилов Art: Gigma ERP операции и e-commerce консультации, generic frontend и backend workflow, GLAIM agent bridge/frontend chat, поддержка сервиса Твой ВПС и development workflow.

plugins.name: gigma-erp
plugins.description: Операционные скилы Gigma ERP через API: create-tenant (новый проект), load-nomenclature (импорт каталога), setup-storefront (витрина+склад+App Token+остатки+контент под ключ), mcp-agent-access, miniapp-auth, counterparty-callback-auth, connect-frontend-api и receive-order-paid-webhook для приёма order.paid/payment webhook. Референс эндпоинтов/контрактов/багов — reference/erp-api.md.

plugins.name: gigma-consultant
plugins.description: Роль «Консультант по интернет-магазинам (e-commerce)» для Codex: полный цикл от выявления потребностей до запуска магазина на Gigma — discovery, подбор решения, КП, план внедрения. Передаёт технику операционным скилам gigma-erp.

plugins.name: vps-support
plugins.description: Твой ВПС: поддержка и подписка, подключение и HAPP, диагностика и авторизованное расследование нод. Все пять скиллов, сетевой анализатор и общий роутинг устанавливаются одним плагином.

plugins.name: glaim
plugins.description: Скилы GLAIM для agent bridge: connect-chat-frontend подключает miniapp, сайт или frontend-чат напрямую к source-chat API, с session/message/events/stop/reset flow и source token только для chat routes.

plugins.name: development-workflow
plugins.description: Generic development workflow skills for high-agency complex-task execution, real-capability routing, session control, security-sensitive execution, project context bootstrap, workflow routing, read-code-first guardrails, prompt architecture porting from untrusted third-party prompts, evidence-first research, explicit clarification of ambiguous code requests, evidence-based handoff, post-merge protocol, PR fix continuation, review gates, deploy checks, dirty worktree safety, wrong-direction recovery and redacted handoff output.

plugins.name: h2d-transfer
plugins.description: Скил для H2D pixel-perfect transfer: перенос .h2d в Tailwind HTML/React с обязательными gates для source intake, geometry, asset paint, live diff, behavior и liveness/WebGL.

plugins.name: site-sense
plugins.description: Русскоязычный набор скилов для полного цикла сайта: product context, positioning, information architecture, content strategy, SEO briefs, page copywriting, conversion review и финальная редактура.

plugins.name: frontend-workflow
plugins.description: Generic frontend engineering skills for planning before code, RTK Query review, affordance and hidden-regression audits, and safe PR finalization across React and TypeScript web apps.

plugins.name: backend-workflow
plugins.description: Generic backend engineering skills for DDD API design and review on FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL and Alembic: bounded contexts, aggregates, transaction ownership, concurrency and isolation, idempotency contracts, migrations, events and outbox, plus an evidence-based production gate.

plugins.name: codex-toolkit
plugins.description: General-purpose agent skills for browser and Electron automation, deterministic image operations, screenshots, GitHub review and CI fixes, security review and threat modeling, provisioning safety, admin UX refinement, and doc-first feature delivery.

plugins.name: first-pass-quality
plugins.description: Phase-aware Task Locks, fresh evidence gates, project-workflow compatibility, bounded delegation, one-shot production authorization, and honest completion. Hooks require pwsh 7 on PATH.

plugins.name: gigma-mcp
plugins.description: Connect an agent to the Gigma owner MCP through native callback onboarding.
